text: Found it: the `returnToolRequests: true` flag in orderStatus causes the model to return tool requests instead of executing them, which leaves the text empty. The fix is to remove that flag, but I want to double check the other flows, agents.ts, orders.json, and the prompts to make sure nothing else relies on that behavior, plus confirm the genkit version semantics.
The likely culprit is `returnToolRequests: true` on line 37 of `src/flows.ts`. I'll confirm in the installed Genkit source what that option does, and check `agents.ts` for the same pattern.

input.command: grep -rn "returnToolRequests" node_modules/genkit/lib/*.js node_modules/@genkit-ai/ai/lib/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo ---; grep -rn "returnToolRequests" src prompts; echo ---; cat src/agents.ts | head -60; echo ---; cat package.json
input.description: Check returnToolRequests semantics in Genkit and other sources
Inspect Genkit generate handling of returnToolRequests

text: That explains it — returnToolRequests true means the tool call is handed back instead of executed, so the response text stays empty. I'll remove that flag to match how orderAgent is set up, which works correctly without it.

Confirmed: `returnToolRequests: true` makes `ai.generate` hand back the model's tool-call request instead of running `lookupOrder`, so `text` is empty. The sibling `orderAgent` in `agents.ts` uses the same tool without that option. I'll remove the option.
I should quickly verify the JSON is valid by parsing it with node, and maybe run a type check too, keeping it brief.
I'll check that `answer.json` parses and that the project still type-checks.

text: The root cause was `returnToolRequests: true` in the `orderStatus` flow (`src/flows.ts:37`). That option makes Genkit hand back the model's `lookupOrder` tool request without running the tool, so the flow returned an empty `text`. I removed the line, and `answer.json` is written to the project root. The project type-checks and `answer.json` parses. I did not run the flow against the model, since that needs the Gemini API key.
